anatomy.demo: 形状 = 功能 原色标记 无衬线粗标题 不对称平衡
anatomy.demo_en: Shape = function Primary accents Sans-serif headlines Asymmetric balance

parts.desc: 圆、方、三角是构图的最小单位
parts.desc_en: Circles, squares, and triangles are the smallest units of the composition

parts.desc: 每个形状负责分区、指示或强调，没有闲笔
parts.desc_en: Every shape divides, points, or emphasizes; nothing is idle decoration

parts.desc: 红黄蓝只用来标记功能关系，面积克制
parts.desc_en: Red, yellow, and blue only mark functional relationships, in restrained areas

parts.desc: 粗标题配直接的信息层级，不使用花体
parts.desc_en: Bold headlines with direct hierarchy and no ornamental letterforms

parts.desc: 元素不必居中对称，但视觉重量仍然稳定
parts.desc_en: Elements need not be centered or mirrored, yet the visual weight stays stable

use.t: 设计展览、美术馆和文化机构官网
以几何构成建立识别的品牌发布页
设计课程、工作坊等强调结构的教育页面
需要海报感主视觉的文化活动页

dont.t: 只铺红黄蓝色块，内容组织没有任何变化
几何形与内容无关，只是贴上去的装饰
形状层层叠压，标题和正文难以阅读
正文也使用粗重几何标题字，长段落读不下去

principles.t: 用圆、方、三角等基础几何形组织画面
每个形状承担功能：分区、指示或强调
原色只标记功能关系，不作装饰填充
无衬线字体和直接的信息层级

history.title: 包豪斯学校在魏玛成立
history.desc: 格罗皮乌斯在德国魏玛创办包豪斯，主张把艺术、工艺和技术重新统一到设计中。
history.title_en: The Bauhaus school opens in Weimar
history.desc_en: Walter Gropius founded the Bauhaus in Weimar, aiming to reunite art, craft, and technology in design.

history.title: 构成语言走向成熟
history.desc: 基础几何形、原色和功能主义在课程与展览中成形，成为可被识别的视觉语言。
history.desc_en: Basic geometry, primary colors, and functionalism took shape across the school's courses and exhibitions.

history.title: 学校关闭，影响扩散
history.desc: 包豪斯在政治压力下关闭，师生流散各地，其教学方法和设计语言进入现代设计教育。
history.title_en: The school closes, its influence spreads
history.desc_en: The school closed under political pressure; its teachers and students carried its methods into modern design education worldwide.

lessonPractice.title: 你让 AI 把展览官网改成包豪斯风格，结果页面只是多了红、黄、蓝色块，内容结构没有变化。怎样判断和反馈？

options.label: 指出配色不等于包豪斯，要求每个几何形承担分区、指示或强调等功能
options.feedback: 包豪斯的判断依据是几何与功能的关系；每个形状都有明确职责时，风格才成立。

options.label: 接受当前方案，包豪斯的核心就是三原色对比，结构可以保持不变
options.feedback: 三原色只是容易被记住的表面特征；只有色块没有功能关系时，页面只是换了配色。

options.label: 改成严格文字网格和无衬线排版，去掉页面里的几何图形
options.feedback: 这是瑞士排版的解决方式；它同样现代，但用网格秩序取代了几何构成，不是包豪斯。

en.title: You asked the AI to take an exhibition site in a Bauhaus direction, and it only added red, yellow, and blue blocks without changing the content structure. How do you judge and respond?

options.label: Point out that a palette is not Bauhaus; every geometric shape must serve a function like dividing, pointing, or emphasizing
options.feedback: Bauhaus is judged by the geometry-function relationship; the style holds only when each shape has a clear job.

options.label: Accept it, since primary-color contrast is the core of Bauhaus and structure can stay
options.feedback: Primary colors are just the most memorable surface trait; blocks without functional roles are only a recolor.

options.label: Switch to a strict text grid with sans-serif type and remove the geometric shapes
options.feedback: That is the Swiss typography answer; it replaces geometric composition with grid order, which is a different movement.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 把展览首页改成包豪斯方向：用圆、方、三角组织主视觉和内容分区，每个形状都要承担功能，原色只用来标记这些功能关系，不要只铺色块。改完后逐个说明每个形状负责什么，再用手机宽度检查阅读顺序。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Take the exhibition home page in a Bauhaus direction: use circles, squares, and triangles to organize the hero and content sections, give every shape a job, and reserve primary colors for marking those functional relationships instead of filling decorative blocks. Afterwards explain what each shape is responsible for, then check the reading order at phone width.

entry.prompt: 做一个设计展览的官网首页，用圆、方、三角组织主视觉和内容分区：每个几何形都要承担分区、指示或强调的功能，红黄蓝只用来标记这些功能关系。标题用粗无衬线字体，正文保持易读。展品信息只用我提供的资料，缺的部分标“待补充”。
entry.prompt_en: Bauhaus exhibition homepage, basic circles squares and triangles organizing the hero and content sections, each shape serving a clear function, primary colors only marking functional relationships, bold sans-serif headlines, readable body text, asymmetric but balanced composition

use.t: Museum, exhibition, and cultural institution sites
Brand launches that build recognition through geometry
Design courses and workshops that emphasize structure
Cultural events that need a poster-like hero

dont.t: Spreading red-yellow-blue blocks while the content structure stays the same
Adding shapes that relate to nothing on the page
Layering shapes until headlines and body text become hard to read
Setting long paragraphs in heavy geometric display type

principles.t: Compose with basic shapes: circles, squares, triangles
Give every shape a job: dividing, pointing, emphasizing
Reserve primary colors for functional relationships
Set headlines in plain, bold sans-serif type

distinctions.label: Swiss Typography
distinctions.text: {c:style-swiss} communicates through a strict text grid and objective typography; in {c:style-bauhaus}, geometry itself is the structure that organizes the page.

distinctions.label: Neubrutalism
distinctions.text: {c:style-brutalism} uses heavy borders, hard shadows, and raw default controls for confrontation; {c:style-bauhaus} composition serves function and balance instead.
